summary: Back to w15 level, with a small net gain from the plastics. Both w16 high/medium artefacts are gone: no black slot on the shell (q14 foreground shell is clean, with soft rim highlights like py_37303), and no side rods on the cushions (p8, p5, p1 window and console sides are open and light, as in py_37301). The lower roughness on the shell, arm and arm pad, the rounder console, nose and shroud, the foot plates and the console split line add no artefacts and look closer to py_37301 / 37303. The one weak point left is the new cushion-front band. It is no longer a pen line (L 9 in w16, L 33 now), but it is still a flat, uniform 4-5 px dark stripe. In py_37301 the crease is a 15-25 px gradient at L 50-90, so in p5 and p8 the band still reads slightly drawn. That is medium, not high. Carry-over lows are unchanged.
lighting_note: Not scored. Shell and arm highlights in q13 / q14 are closer to the photos. The window-side seats are still flat-lit compared with py_37302.
